content:
Ben Park: Heads up — proposal: split internal failure signals into three client-visible buckets and reflect them in console badges + telemetry. Thoughts?
Alice Li: quick q — what are the three buckets?
Ben Park: 1) quota_exceeded -> 429 + X-RW-Reason:quota
2) capacity_surge -> 503 + Retry-After when we can estimate
3) model_error -> 500/502 with fingerprint id for rerun analysis
Carla M.: I like separating quota vs capacity. For quota we should show a per-tenant quota badge in the console. :thumbsup:
Evan G.: For capacity_surge, better to return 503 with a short retry-after or a numeric backoff_hint header. Users can decide to queue.
Ben Park: Agreed. Here's a sample response we could standardize:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Retry-After: 3
X-Redwood-Reason: capacity_surge
X-Redwood-Fingerprint: a1b2c3
```
Alice Li: Should we expose a compact 'client_hint' field in JSON body for SDKs to parse? e.g. {"client_hint":"retry_short","quota_bucket":"prompt_tokens"}
Carla M.: SDKs will like it. But keep header-first for HTTP purists. Body hint as fallback.
DevOps Bot: deploy triggered: feature/err-buckets -> staging
Grace (bot): Dashboard proposal: new 'Degradation' badge (green/yellow/red) per route + tooltip listing dominant reason (quota|capacity|model). 
Evan G.: Telemetry: tag traces with reason and a severity score. Also emit aggregated time-series counts for console charting.
Alice Li: UX note — don't spam users with banners for model errors; show only if >1% of calls fail for 5m.
Ben Park: Action items: 1) Evan: prototype headers + telemetry tags (ETA Tue). 2) Carla: console badge mockups (ETA Wed). 3) Alice: SDK hint contract (ETA Thu). I'll draft RFC.
Carla M.: I'll put mocks in #design by EOD. :ok_hand:
Evan G.: starting prototype now.
Ben Park: thanks all — sync in next eng-platform sync if needed.
